title: Rate, Speed and Fractions Unit Test
subject: math

items.prompt: A bus travels at 60 km/h for 2.5 hours. Find the distance it travels. Show your working.

points.text: Builds the parts: 60 km in each full hour plus 30 km in the half hour
Multiplies speed by time to get 60 × 2.5 = 150 km

items.prompt: Explain why a bus travelling at 60 km/h for half an hour has not travelled 60 km.

points.text: States that 60 km/h is a rate - 60 km covered in every full hour, not a distance already travelled
Concludes half the time gives half the distance, so the bus has gone 30 km, not 60

items.prompt: A baker uses 3/4 kg of flour in the morning and 1/4 kg in the afternoon. How much flour is used in total?

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Working is complete, ordered and uses correct rate, speed and fraction notation throughout.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Working is partial or notation is inconsistent, but the method can be followed.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Little or no working shown; the method cannot be followed.
